purpose: Allow future Gunjo Zankyoroku subjects to enter the visual master backlog according to their authorized incident role without assuming a fixed member count, humanoid boss roster, or organization.

subjectTypes.masterPolicy: Create or reuse one individual Character/Person setting Master after formal Gunjo admission. If the same person already has an approved Character Master, reference that lineage instead of copying the image.
Create a group comparison/staging Master only after group composition is authoritative; individual member Masters are created/reused only for authoritative members.
Create system/process/environment/interface/record-setting Masters as appropriate. Do not personify the system into a humanoid boss unless Story authority separately defines one.
Use information-flow, crowd/environment, media, signage-free diagram, color/light and record-reference plates as appropriate. Do not invent one mascot villain to stand for the social pressure.
Reuse the approved Sakuyaza member Master and add only incident-specific staging/reference evidence when needed. Never duplicate the same Sakuyaza character image under a Gunjo asset ID.

formalAdmissionGate: what the subject wanted is defined
what the subject feared is defined when person/group based
choice / non-choice or system pressure role is defined
role is not reduced to one evil-person shortcut
Kokuyou/social wrong-arrival thematic mirror is defined where applicable
Sakuyaza relation is defined or explicitly NO_DIRECT_CONTACT / UNKNOWN
combat Boss role is independently decided
Reality full-name reveal relevance is defined for person subjects
Happy End / re-choice boundary is defined where applicable
source and spoiler authority are attached
dedupeRules: existing Character Master wins over a duplicate Gunjo portrait
existing Sakuyaza Master wins over a duplicate Gunjo portrait
same physical archive source is referenced, not copied per Incident
one Incident may reference multiple subject Masters
one subject may appear in multiple Incident boards without duplicating its Master binary
forbidden: Gunjo membership badge or faction emblem without separate authority
every Gunjo subject as combat boss
八影 or 朔夜座 treated as another name for Gunjo
generated image creating a new Gunjo member or Incident
